question.text: I put my son on my shoulders in order that [^he could see better|he can see better].
question.modelAnswerString: I put my son on my shoulders in order that he could see better.

question.text: I left the keys out so that [I won't forget them|^I wouldn't forget them].
question.modelAnswerString: I left the keys out so that I wouldn't forget them.

question.text: The tin opener is designed [such as it can be used by left- or right-handed people|^such that it can be used by left- or right-handed people].

question.text: I didn't want to eat any lunch because [^I had such a big breakfast|I had such big breakfast].

question.text: I packed my suitcase the night before so that [^I wouldn't have to rush in the morning|I won't have to rush in the morning].

question.text: Dimitra gave me the door code in order [^that I could get in when she wasn't at home|I could get in when she wasn't at home].

question.text: The windows are made of tinted glass so that [it was not too bright during the summer|^it is not too bright during the summer].

question.text: The wind farm has been located in [^such a way that it can't be seen from the nearby town|such way that it can't be seen from the nearby town].

question.text: During the winter, chains are put on car tyres in order that [^they grip the road better in the ice and snow|they gripped the road better in the ice and snow].
